biggest_catch: First-time quirk: you need at least one purchase and over $1 in purchase-derived cashback — bonus-only balances can never be withdrawn.
catches: Cashback rates vary by store and offer; cashback is not guaranteed income.
At least $10 in available cashback is required, plus at least one purchase and over $1 in purchase-derived cashback.
Merchant and category exclusions apply; gift-card purchases are commonly excluded.
Merchants report orders in 1–7 days; further confirmation time may apply before cashback is available.
Purchases must be tracked through Extrabux; ad blockers or broken affiliate attribution can mean no credit.
Extrabux tracks your shopping activity — a real privacy trade-off.

steps: Install the Extrabux browser extension (or use the Extrabux site) and create a free account.
Click through Extrabux before shopping at a participating store — disable ad blockers and competing extensions.
Complete the purchase; the merchant reports the order in 1–7 days.
Track your available cashback balance in your account.

Once you have at least $10 available — including at least one purchase and over $1 in purchase-derived cashback — request payment via PayPal or mailed check (typically paid within five business days).
